title: OpenAI - Unable to create new ChatGPT Work threads in latest version of desktop app
text:
Service: OpenAI
Incident: Unable to create new ChatGPT Work threads in latest version of desktop app
Status: resolved
Impact: major
Started: None
Resolved: 2026-10-07T11:53:35Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-07T11:53:35Z: resolved - We have released an updated app version with the fix for Linux, macOS and Windows. Affected users should update to the latest version.
- 2026-10-07T11:06:45Z: identified - We are actively working on a fixed app version for Windows. 
- 2026-10-07T09:28:55Z: identified - We have identified the issue. We have released an updated app version for Linux and macOS. We are actively working to roll out the fix for Windows. 
- 2026-10-07T05:54:27Z: identified - we have identified the issue, working on rolling back to the previous version. 
- 2026-10-07T05:31:56Z: investigating - We are investigating the issue. Version 26.1002.51308 is affected
